{{Top|leg}}
'''Fete Day''' was a day were the galaxy celebrated the start of a new [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. On the Fete Day of [[Great ReSynchronization|15 GrS]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] made a broadcast, that partially managed to get distributed amongst [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-sanctioned Fete Day messages. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] impacted the Fete Day greatly, as curfews and armed partols limited the celebrations.
